decision: Request a replacement web-root builder because the reviewed web lineage is exhausted and the last bounded replay path regressed. The next useful multilingual improvement step is fresh source-backed web root generation, not more replay on the old frontier.
why_now: All reviewed web bundles in the surviving Stage10111/10119/10176 lineage already overlap the current miss frontier.
Stage10256 showed that prioritized compact-bounded replay does not repair the multilingual weakness package and can make it worse.
Web remains the only language family with no safe reviewed replenishment source for compact-bounded support.

freshness: Must come from source/session lineage not present in the current miss frontier.
Must not reuse the bddy 440e122a0f lineage.
Must not reuse the bddy f0be60dc44 lineage.
Must not reuse the code_assist 3a0f6d8311 lineage.
source_backing: Must include stable source/session identity fields sufficient to prove root-level independence.
Must preserve repo_id, source/session identifiers, candidate paths, and any selected_tests or verifier anchors that exist.
Must retain enough raw evidence to reconstruct maintainer-visible prompts without template-only shells.
maintainer_grade_evidence: Visible evidence must include concrete file or symbol references, not only abstract category descriptions.
At least one of failure text, selected test/assertion, trace/call-path evidence, or candidate-path-local snippet evidence must be present.
Abstention must remain available whenever visible evidence does not justify a singleton answer.
anti_cheat: Reject roots that are solvable primarily from changed-path signatures, candidate-order priors, or obvious surface-family aliases.
Prefer roots with selected_tests or verifier constraints because the existing reviewed web bundles without tests were shortcut-prone.
Require explicit leakage scan against current eval roots before training or comparison use.

standalone_train_support: Fresh web roots may be used for train support only after root-level leakage scan confirms disjointness from the live eval frontier.
If evidence is underconstrained, restrict use to abstention-only honesty rows rather than singleton scoring rows.
standalone_scoring: Do not score new web roots until expert/rubric and anti-cheat reviews are complete.
Score by root bundle coherence first, perspective rows second.
harness_scoring: Only promote fresh web roots into the locked task-pack/harness track once the same root bundle has a stable machine-readable prompt contract and writeback mapping.
Harness rows must preserve same-task-pack identity across 100M and Gemma.

success_criteria: At least two new web root bundles exist and are provably disjoint from the current miss frontier.
Each new root has non-template maintainer-visible evidence and explicit anti-cheat review inputs.
Each new root can be compiled into standalone prompt rows and into the reserved harness writeback shape without changing evaluation semantics.
next_best_step: Materialize fresh web roots from unused source/session evidence under this contract, then build a small admitted web replacement packet before any further multilingual weakness replay.
